Macrons

Consonantal i

Tools, fasteners & household repair

hammer noun

also mallet, maul

classical

malleus, malleī m.

noun, second declension

hammer, mallet or maul

Examples

  • Malleum mihi dā.

    Give me the hammer.composed

  • Dā mihi, ōrō, ūtendum malleum, tata!

    Lend me the hammer, please, Dad!Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

See also nail, tool.

SourcesLewis & Short: malleus

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.

Dā mihi, ōrō, ūtendum malleum, tata! is after Pont. Progymn. I 35; quoted in Libellus VII.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
